# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want Oli to be a welcoming project for everyone, regardless of age, background, experience level,
identity, or nationality. We pledge to keep participation harassment-free and respectful.

## Expected behavior

- Be kind, patient, and constructive.
- Respect differing viewpoints and experience levels.
- Give and accept feedback gracefully; keep it about the work, not the person.
- Assume good intent, and ask when something is unclear.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, insults, threats, or discriminatory language.
- Personal or political attacks, trolling, or deliberately derailing discussions.
- Publishing someone's private information without permission.
- Spam, advertising, or posting links to pirated music or other infringing material.

## Scope

This applies to all project spaces: issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other place where
someone represents the project.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close or lock threads, and block people who break these
rules. To report a problem, open a [private security advisory](https://github.com/CyttoRak-J/Oli/security/advisories/new)
or contact the maintainer, [@CyttoRak-J](https://github.com/CyttoRak-J), through GitHub. Reports are
handled privately.
